message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes around **6–7 hours** under normal conditions—about 380 miles (≈610 km) along I‑5. In heavy traffic or during rush hour it can stretch to 8–9 hours, while on a clear day you might get there in roughly 6 hours if you maintain an average speed of 60 mph (≈97 kph).
